author: Mila (bondmila, AI-assisted)
summary: Scope private context reports to POSIX and fail closed elsewhere
details: Address Michael’s PR #58 changes request without weakening privacy: unsupported hosts reject report output before filesystem or GPIO/audio access; retain exclusive 0600/private-directory guards on POSIX. Mark five report-success tests POSIX-only, add portable rejection/no-side-effect tests, and document platform limits. Integrate accepted main including narration #41.
validation: 186 combined edge tests passed on macOS before accepted-main sync; native dependency and shared repository checks recorded in the handoff. Windows paths are simulated in portable regression tests, not actual Windows-host validation. No new hardware or deployment acceptance.
